metadata.purpose: Semantic color palette for elite content intelligence engine
metadata.rationale: Cyber-Slate & Electric Cyan aesthetic. Obsidian reduces eye strain; Cyan drives focus to intelligence; Coral strictly reserved for alerts.

primary.usage: Primary actions, intelligence extractions, active states, progress indicators
primary.psychology: Vibrant, high-energy, signals 'machine intelligence' and precision

secondary.usage: Accent borders, secondary highlights, subtle gradients (sparingly)

tertiary.usage: Strictly for warnings, critical AI insights, destructive actions

contrast_audit.note: Primary Cyan (#06B6D4) on Slate Background (#0F172A) provides high readability. Text primary meets WCAG AAA standards.
